boundary_rule: Capital Capability Gates may consume Control Plane evidence, but may never grant, weaken, bypass, or modify Control Plane authority.

capital_gates.note: No capital gate is defined yet. Gate criteria are written just-in-time, immediately before evidence collection for that gate (P4).

principles.name: Preregistered Gates
principles.mechanism: waves/*.yaml exit_criteria fixed before execution; no rule forbids post-hoc amendment

principles.name: Independence of Verification
principles.mechanism: runner/gates.py evaluate_gate: rejects agent PASS without probes/results/before-after digests, detects severity downgrade. NOT full P5: evidence.agent_claim (verdict + free-text notes) is a required field of the evidence schema, so any verifier reading an evidence pack also reads the producer's conclusion. Harmless for the deterministic verifier; exactly what P5 forbids for an agent verifier.

principles.name: LIVE as Leased Capability
principles.mechanism: constitution/rules.json live_trading=false + runner/stops.py check_live_trading; lease itself not implemented

principles.name: Independent Kill Switch
principles.mechanism: runner/detectors/kill_switch.py invoked by runner.gates.evaluate_gate -> run_kill_switch_detectors; stop state must not be writable by this process, unreadable denies, reading does not mutate, ENGAGED denies, and a drill must show a real transition within the cadence against a pinned commit. Reached on every gate via UPTM-005: the scope declaration is mandatory, absence resolves to UNKNOWN, a declared bearing requires its pack, and carrying a pack while declaring the gate does not bear it is a gate_bypass_attempt.
principles.residual: Not avoidable by omission. What remains is a gate stating something untrue in signed evidence, which is forgery rather than avoidance and belongs to UPTM-002's class of problem.

principles.name: No Progress Illusion
principles.mechanism: this file: enforcement status per principle; no readiness board

principles.name: Validation Capital
principles.mechanism: runner/detectors/validation_capital.py invoked by runner.gates.evaluate_gate -> run_validation_capital_detectors; an aggregating ceiling, a currency rule that refuses to convert, and a ban on return as a gate criterion that still permits reporting PnL. Reached on every gate via UPTM-005: the scope declaration is mandatory, absence resolves to UNKNOWN, a declared bearing requires its pack, and carrying a pack while declaring the gate does not bear it is a gate_bypass_attempt.
principles.residual: Not avoidable by omission. What remains is a gate stating something untrue in signed evidence, which is forgery rather than avoidance and belongs to UPTM-002's class of problem.

principles.name: Uncertainty Halts
principles.mechanism: constitution/rules.json fail_closed=true; runner/gates.py fails closed on missing/unloadable evidence; State.HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Covers the evidence dimension only. P11 also binds orders, positions, accounts, execution and data; no such runtime exists yet, so those are unenforced rather than satisfied.

principles.name: Evidence Has Commit & Expiry
principles.mechanism: commit: evaluated head read from the repository (Evidence Rule A, not asserted by the caller). expiry: expires_at computed from evidence_expiry_days=7, evaluable via expiry_status. binding: evaluate_gate verifies every declared files[].sha256 against the tree and denies on STALE or UNKNOWN (UPTM-008). Routes P12-R1..R5 in the UPTM-006 registry, each denying via its own check.
principles.earned_by: UPTM-008. Criteria preregistered in docs/specs/UPTM-008-gate-verifies-its-binding.md before the code existed; G1-G7, R1-R3 all pass, measured after implementation.
principles.what_this_does_not_establish: That the declared set is COMPLETE. The gate now proves the declaration is TRUE - every file the evidence names really is in that state. It does not prove the evidence names everything that mattered: a producer declaring one irrelevant file and omitting ten that matter satisfies every route here. Choosing what evidence MUST declare is a separate, unbuilt wall. Read ENFORCED as 'no route to PASS with a false binding', not as 'the binding is sufficient'.

principles.name: Versioned Amendment
principles.mechanism: capital and governance documents versioned; control-plane CONSTITUTION.md versioned as of this change; no amendment log

control_plane_stop_condition_status.note: Verified by reading runner/stops.py, runner/fsm.py and runner/gates.py. Declared != detected (P9), and a detector nothing calls is not detection either. fabricated_market_data and fabricated_pnl are PARTIAL as of UPTM-002c: the gate invokes the detectors and its verdict follows them, but evidence that declares no pack bypasses them entirely (omission_bypass), and local consistency is not external authenticity.

preexisting_capability_status.note: Capabilities that exist in UPTM predate this constitution. Under P12/P14 they are unverified against it, not unusable.

enforcement_summary.note: Counted from principles[].enforcement. P8 and P10 are ENFORCED: mechanised, invoked, proven load-bearing under mutation, and no longer avoidable by omission. What remains for them is a false declaration, which is forgery rather than avoidance.

uptm002_detector.reachability_proof: tests/test_detector_invocation.py: a spy asserts the gate calls each detector, and a disconnection test asserts the gate's verdict changes when the detector's return value changes - import alone proves nothing.

open_limits.omission_bypass: Evidence that declares neither market_data nor pnl never reaches the detectors. Closing this needs an evidence-schema declaration that a run which used market data must carry the pack, with absence resolving to UNKNOWN. That changes the evidence schema and is a separate decision.
open_limits.local_consistency_only: A fully consistent forged snapshot with matching ledger and marks passes all 13 checks. Closing this needs source-authenticated provenance.

uptm003_detector.reachability_proof: tests/test_detector_invocation.py: spies assert the gate calls both detect_kill_switch and detect_kill_switch_drill and that the drill detector receives the cadence from this file; a disconnection test asserts the gate's verdict follows the detector's return value. Eight mutations - dropping the verdict from the fold, deleting the KS-I3b invariant, neutering the KS-I1 probe, and five that neuter KS-D5 or KS-D6 after a change they alone catch - each turn the suite red at the tests naming that property. Import alone proves nothing.
uptm003_detector.amendments_before_evidence: A1: KS-I1 probes os.access rather than scanning runner/ sources - a scan is forgeable and would evidence tidy code, not the capability. A2: preregistered case 13 contradicted case 3; the engaged stop now FAILs with a detail naming it as the switch working, and a separate gate invariant refuses any PASS produced while ENGAGED. Both made before the detector produced a verdict; see spec section 5a.

open_limits.deployment_topology: A process cannot certify its own deployment. That the stop path is not co-located with the Runner, under the same credentials and failure domain, is a Founder attestation recorded with a date - never a PASS produced by code. KS-D6 checks that such an attestation exists, is dated and is not older than the deployment it describes; it cannot check that it is true.
open_limits.root: For uid 0 the writability probe reports writable whatever the file mode says. That is the correct answer - a Runner running as root can clear its own stop - but nothing here prevents that deployment; it only refuses to pass the gate.
open_limits.drill_against_mock: A drill that exercised a stand-in rather than the real stop path still shows a valid before/after transition. KS-D4 narrows this by pinning the commit and the path, and KS-D5 by pinning the deployment, credentials and gate path; neither closes it.
open_limits.time_source: KS-D2 trusts the clock it is given. A forged last_drill_at inside an otherwise consistent pack is not detected here.
open_limits.omission_bypass: CLOSED by UPTM-005. Evidence carrying no kill_switch pack once bypassed these checks entirely; the scope declaration is now mandatory and unconditional, and its absence resolves to UNKNOWN. Kept as a closed entry rather than removed so the hole and its closure stay auditable together.

uptm003_detector.ported_checks: KS-D5 (drill invalidated by a change to deployment_ref, credentials_ref or gate_path_digest, independently of the cadence window) and KS-D6 (dated operator attestation of deployment independence, checked for existence and currency, never for truth) were ported from the parallel implementation in PR #9, closed unmerged, on the Founder's instruction 2026-09-23. Both were in the Founder's original brief for this wall. See spec section 7a.
uptm003_detector.enforced_since: UPTM-005 (PR #10). P8 was PARTIAL for one stated reason - evidence omitting the kill_switch pack was never examined - and the mandatory scope declaration closed it. The old why_not_enforced text was left behind by that upgrade and is removed here rather than kept as a rationale for a status that no longer holds.

uptm004_detector.reachability_proof: tests/test_detector_invocation.py: spies assert the gate calls both detect_validation_capital and detect_return_as_criterion, that the first receives the tranche read from this file and the second the exit_criteria read from waves/wave3.yaml; a disconnection test asserts the gate's verdict follows the detector. Four mutations - dropping the verdict from the fold, neutering VC-I3, neutering VC-R1, letting VC-I4 compare across currencies - each turn the suite red at the tests naming that property.
uptm004_detector.founder_parameter_required: validation_capital.amount, .currency and .applies_to are unset. Every capital gate denies until all three are set.
uptm004_detector.closes_from_uptm002: omission_bypass, for a gate declaring capital_gate=true and carrying no capital pack: UNKNOWN rather than silence.

open_limits.gate_that_never_declares_itself: CLOSED by UPTM-005. A gate that declared nothing once bypassed these checks entirely; the scope declaration is now mandatory and unconditional, and its absence resolves to UNKNOWN. Kept as a closed entry rather than removed so the hole and its closure stay auditable together.
open_limits.disguised_return_criteria: VC-R1 matches named return metrics compared against a number. A criterion phrased as an equity curve or an account balance encodes return without naming it and is not caught; a reviewer still has to read the criteria.
open_limits.under_declared_exposure: This detector binds declarations. Whether a declaration matches reality is UPTM-002's job; neither substitutes for the other.
open_limits.criteria_outside_the_wave_file: VC-R1 reads waves/wave{N}.yaml exit_criteria plus evidence gate_criteria. A criterion agreed elsewhere is not seen.
open_limits.free_text_justification: VC-R2 reads agent_claim.basis, a structured list. A PASS argued in prose is not parsed - deliberately, since matching prose would produce false positives on the honest reporting P10 wants.
open_limits.leverage_and_notional: Whether a notional position with a protective stop counts as the stop distance or the notional is a Founder decision recorded in applies_to, not an inference.

uptm004_detector.enforced_since: UPTM-005 (PR #10). P10 was PARTIAL for one stated reason - a gate that never set capital_gate was never examined - and the mandatory scope declaration closed it. The old why_not_enforced text was left behind by that upgrade and is removed here rather than kept as a rationale for a status that no longer holds. Matches the correction made to uptm003_detector in PR #12.

validation_capital.note: Set by the Founder 2026-09-23. EUR 700 is the size of the TEST, not the size of the opportunity. per_position_at_risk is deliberately NOT a separate cap: it is implicitly covered by the stricter aggregate-open-exposure limit, so adding it would be a second number saying less than the first. PnL may be reported; profit and loss may NOT be used as an acceptance criterion of the validation experiment - a result that passes because it made money has measured the wrong thing (P10, and VC-R1 enforces it).

evidence_expiry.note: Set by the Founder 2026-09-24. Seven days because that is the kill-switch drill cadence: enforcement evidence must never outlive the drill it rests on. One rhythm rather than two removes the case where valid-looking evidence is propped up by a drill that has already gone stale, and it needs no separate rule to say so.
evidence_expiry.does_not_satisfy_p12: Expiry is one half of P12 (Evidence Has Commit & Expiry). The other half - STALE invalidation when a dependency changes - is not implemented. Evidence can still be inside its seven days and describe code that has since moved. P12 therefore stays PARTIAL, and this parameter does not change that.

uptm005_detector.founder_decision: absence of the declaration resolves to UNKNOWN, not to 'not applicable' (2026-09-23)
uptm005_detector.reachability_proof: tests/test_scope_declaration.py: a spy asserts the gate calls detect_scope on every gate, and a disconnection test asserts the gate's verdict follows its return value. Four mutations - dropping the verdict from the fold, letting SC-P1 accept a missing declaration, disabling SC-I3, and dropping the required-pack rule - each turn the suite red at the tests naming that property.
uptm005_detector.breaking_change: Evidence written before this wall carries no scope and denies until declared. runner.fsm.run_baseline_ack now emits the declaration, so a regenerated wave 0 ack is declared at the producer rather than patched afterwards.

open_limits.false_declaration: This wall makes the declaration mandatory and self-consistent. It cannot tell whether the declaration is true. A gate declaring live_bearing false while actually bearing LIVE has not avoided the check - it has lied in signed evidence.

uptm006_enforcement_evidence.subject: the ENFORCED claims in this file
uptm006_enforcement_evidence.invocation_path: tests/test_enforcement_evidence.py on every run; python -m runner.cli enforcement-evidence --commit <sha> as a CI step
uptm006_enforcement_evidence.claim_gate: A principle reading ENFORCED with no registered routes fails the suite. ENFORCED is no longer a word that can be typed into this file - it has to be earned. The guard is itself tested against a fabricated P99 claim, because a guard that cannot fail is not a guard.
uptm006_enforcement_evidence.what_a_route_must_show: It denies when driven through the real evaluate_gate; it denies via its own named check rather than an unrelated one; and neutering its named guards opens it. A route that still denies with its guards removed is denied by something else and names the wrong guard.
uptm006_enforcement_evidence.found_not_designed: P8-R2 and P10-R2 were preregistered with one guard each. The load-bearing test refused both - neutering run_scope_detector alone left each still denying - so the registry was corrected to what the gate does rather than the test loosened to what the spec guessed.
uptm006_enforcement_evidence.conditional_guard: None. This field previously claimed P10-R2 was guarded twice only because validation_capital was unset, and that setting the tranche would drop it to one guard. Measured after setting it: false - the capital detector's hold on that route is VC-P2 (a pack carried without declaring capital_gate), which is structural. The refuted prediction is kept in runner/enforcement.py as CORRECTED_PREDICTIONS with a test asserting it stays there.
uptm006_enforcement_evidence.expiry: The manifest carries an evaluated head and an expires_at timestamp computed from generated_at plus evidence_expiry_days (7, set by the Founder 2026-09-24). Before that date no lifetime was preregistered and expires_at was null, because inventing one at generation time would be the sourceless number UPTM-002 exists to catch. P12 stays PARTIAL: expiry is satisfied, STALE invalidation on dependency change is not.
uptm006_enforcement_evidence.advances_no_status: This wall makes two existing ENFORCED claims checkable. It does not make P9 or P12 ENFORCED, and it does not change any principle's enforcement value.

open_limits.route_list_completeness: Every enumerated route denies. A route nobody thought of is not covered, and no test closes that. This is the honest ceiling of the wall.
open_limits.declaration_truth: Inherited from UPTM-005: a gate that lies in signed evidence has not found a route, it has committed forgery. That belongs to UPTM-002.
open_limits.no_expiry: Without a preregistered lifetime the manifest is a record of a run, not standing evidence. P12 is satisfied on commit and unsatisfied on expiry.

uptm006_enforcement_evidence.routes_the_tranche_made_possible: P10-R4 and P10-R6 through R9 did not exist before 2026-09-23. Until validation_capital was set there was no ceiling to step over, so no route could test one: VC-P1 denied every capital gate before any other check was reached. Setting it also exposed a defect in this module's own capital fixture, which had invented the pack field names aggregate_open_exposure and per_position_at_risk where the detector reads at_risk. Nothing had ever got far enough to read them.
uptm006_enforcement_evidence.no_expiry: SUPERSEDED 2026-09-24 by evidence_expiry_days: 7. Read as written at the time: 'Without a preregistered lifetime the manifest is a record of a run, not standing evidence. P12 is satisfied on commit and unsatisfied on expiry.' The first half no longer holds; the manifest now expires. P12 remains unsatisfied on dependency-change invalidation, which is a different gap from the one this line named.

uptm008_binding.what_was_open: Measured on main at dcf77f4: evaluate_gate returned PASS for evidence declaring a file that does not exist, with a digest never computed from anything. validate_evidence_structure required the files key to be present; nothing ever compared its contents to the repository. That is P12's violation clause, live.
uptm008_binding.no_new_field: The binding already existed in the contract and every producer already emitted it. No schema change, no producer migration - the gate started checking what it was already handed.
uptm008_binding.three_valued: CURRENT passes; STALE and UNKNOWN deny. A missing or malformed declaration is UNKNOWN, never skipped: absence is not a measurement.
